description: FIKWater publishes hot- and cold-water consumption measurements from three restaurant kitchens in Portugal. The research team used ultrasonic flow meters at five-second sampling intervals, with consecutive monitoring periods lasting two to four weeks at each kitchen. Public OSF metadata identifies the dataset and supporting descriptions of the monitored spaces, and registry rights grant CC BY 4.0 for free reuse. These site-specific series can calibrate water-demand simulations, hot-water sizing or service-sector end-use models. Short observation windows and three kitchens provide limited evidence for seasonal or national demand patterns. The inspected metadata did not establish file formats or calendar dates. No directly related catalogue dataset was identified.
name: FIKWater: A Water Consumption Dataset from Three Restaurant Kitchens in Portugal
notes: G4-0353; G4 other data journals. Metadata only. Simulation uses are reviewer assessments. Data payloads and code execution were not checked.
